name: Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche S.A.
summary: Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche S.A. engages in the electrical energy, transmission, distribution, and supply of electrical energy in Chile. As of December 31, 2025, it has a total net capacity of 8,904 MW comprising 3,666 MW hydroelectric generation units; 1,965 MW gas or oil-fired thermal power plants; 2,084 MW solar plants; 903 MW wind generation units; 83 MW geothermal capacity; and 203 MW energy storage systems. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Santiago, Chile. Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche S.A. is a subsidiary of Enel Generación Chile S.A.
